authorship: Agent-authored questions and reference answers; agent-reviewed generated claims. No independent human or legal review.
split: 40 held-out sections absent from the original 20 development sections; two correlated variants each. Topic is the independent sampling unit. Entire source corpus is indexed for both sets.

retrieval_protocol.relevance: Complete normalized gold passage present in a returned chunk; unjudged alternate evidence may also be valid. No claim of exhaustive recall.
retrieval_protocol.tuning: Use only v1 development questions. Freeze code and settings before new holdout ranking. Retain failures and regressions.
retrieval_protocol.timing: Serial local CPU service calls, excludes HTTP, cold index creation and generation; not an isolated server load test.

generation_protocol.cases: One paraphrase for each of 40 topics plus all 20 negatives, 60 total
generation_protocol.sources: Top six v2 hybrid excerpts; source-scope guard skips unsupported current-law requests
generation_protocol.sampling: Greedy, one completion per query; no selection of best outputs
generation_protocol.contract: Shared production evidence prompt/schema and citation validator. Local generator component test; not production OpenAI or classifier/end-to-end API performance.
generation_protocol.review: Every returned claim reviewed against only its cited passages, with supporting quote and reasoning. Assess answer completeness separately against reference. Abstentions do not count as supported claims.
metrics: fully supported complete answers / all answerable cases
generation_protocol.tuning: Generation settings selected using only development smoke cases, frozen before holdout generation. Questions, labels and judgments are agent-authored; not independent evaluation.
